positive.point: Dashing during the holidays, especially the week of Thanksgiving, is expected to be busy with both shopping and restaurant orders.
Dashing on Friday nights, especially during dinner rush, is highly profitable, with potential earnings of $120-140 in a 10-hour shift.
Some dashers appreciate the lack of traffic during overnight dashing, making it easier to cover long distances.
Dashing in big cities can be non-stop at any time of the day, providing consistent opportunities for orders.

negative.point: Overnight dashing has become less profitable, with fewer orders and lower earnings compared to previous experiences.
Dashers experience frustration with low-paying orders, often receiving offers that are not worth the mileage.
Economic factors, such as government shutdowns, have led to a noticeable decline in orders and tips.
Dashing during snow season can be concerning for some due to road conditions, impacting their willingness to work.
